title: Counts of complementary block predicates
statement: For natural numbers $q,K$, a predicate $B$ on finite bit strings, and a finite bit string $l$, the number of the first $K$ consecutive length-$q$ blocks of $l$ satisfying $B$ plus the number satisfying its negation is $K$.
